C0150.title: Shanghai Police Dismantle Game Account Factory, Case Value Exceeds 2 Million Yuan
keywords: illegal acquisition of computer information system data
C0150.summary: In April 2026, China Chang’an Net reported that Shanghai police had cracked a case involving illegal acquisition of computer information system data and dismantled a criminal group that created, nurtured, and sold game accounts. Police arrested 10 suspects including Zhang. The group used more than ten thousand pieces of citizen identity information as raw material, combined an “all-purpose registration machine,” IP pools, and scripts to register and nurture accounts in bulk, then sold them through e-commerce channels. The case value exceeded 2 million yuan.
